name: dev-discipline
description: PreToolUse discipline hooks that fire at the trigger word, where memory entries don't: pause-and-pick reminders (about-to-`rmap new`, about-to-add-`[[task]]`-via-direct-edit, about-to-`sleep N`/poll) plus four roadmap/tasks.toml integrity guards — block masking work as `assignee = "human"` without a `# human:` blocker, block dead model pins (`model = "gpt-5-codex"`), warn on demand-hedge phrasing, warn on evidenceless `status = "done"`, and block filing a task that is an instance of a class existing tasks already cover (searching every status, not just `pending`).
